# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 27 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 8 tokens; Z index — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #fcfaf6);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #22201d);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fcfaf6;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #fcfaf6 | #22201d | Cards, panels, modals, table body, inputs. The main working surface. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #eeeae2 | #151412 | Table header rows, read-only fields, code blocks, the track behind progress bars. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-hover` | #f0ece5 | #2a2824 |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */

```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #211e1a | #ece7de | Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken (≥13.8:1). Warm near-black, never #000. |
| `--ink-muted` | #5e574d | #aba397 | Secondary text, helper text, table meta, placeholders (≥5.9:1 on bg, surface, sunken). |

### Tokens (27)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #f5f2ec | #1a1917 | App canvas behind panels and cards. Warm off-white (not pure white) to cut glare during long sessions; warm charcoal (not pure black) in dark. |
| `--sidebar` | #26231f | #121110 | Left navigation rail in all three products. The one deep 'black' block of the brand. |
| `--sidebar-active` | #3a3630 | #26231f | Selected nav item background inside the sidebar. |
| `--line` | #e3ddd3 | #35322d | Hairline dividers, card borders, table row separators. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control. |
| `--line-strong` | #8e867a | #77705f | Borders of inputs, checkboxes, selects (3.4:1 / 3.3:1 on surface, meets the 3:1 control rule). |
| `--primary` | #4a5a36 | #a9b98f | Moss green. Primary buttons, active tab underline, links, selected checkbox, progress fill. Text-safe on surface (7.2:1 / 7.8:1). |
| `--primary-hover` | #3d4b2c | #bac8a2 | Hover/pressed state of primary fills. |
| `--primary-soft` | #e5e9da | #2c3224 | Selected row, active filter chip, current nav in light content areas. primary text on it is 6.1:1. |
| `--accent` | #9a5034 | #da8e6b | Clay / terracotta — the 'spark'. Brand moments only: logo chip, onboarding highlights, 'New' badges, one key KPI. Not for buttons. |
| `--success` | #3d6b48 | #8ec29b | Won deals, completed tasks, approved leave, 'Active' employees. Always paired with a label or icon. |
| `--success-soft` | #e1ecdf | #21302a | Background for success badges and alerts. |
| `--warning` | #855f12 | #d8af5e | Ochre. Due soon, pending approval, probation, at-risk projects. |
| `--warning-soft` | #f4ead2 | #3a3020 | Background for warning badges and alerts. |
| `--danger` | #a13a2c | #e68d7f | Brick. Overdue, lost deal, rejected, destructive buttons, field errors. |
| `--danger-soft` | #f5e0db | #3d2420 | Background for danger badges, error alerts and invalid-field fill. |
| `--info` | #3b5e71 | #8fb4c8 | Dusty slate blue. Neutral system notices, 'In review', informational links in alerts. |
| `--info-soft` | #dfe9ee | #1f2d35 | Background for info badges and alerts. |
| `--focus-ring` | #9a5034 | #da8e6b | Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid with 2px offset. Clay so it never blends with moss primary (5.3:1 on bg). |
| `--product-sales` | #9a5034 | #da8e6b | Product marker for Sales & CRM — only on the product logo chip in the sidebar header. |
| `--product-projects` | #4a5a36 | #a9b98f | Product marker for Project Management — logo chip only. |
| `--product-people` | #3b5e71 | #8fb4c8 | Product marker for HR & People — logo chip only. |

| ramp | step and value (light) | step and value (dark) |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 28px/36px Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 28px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | One per page at most: dashboard welcome or big KPI number. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 22px / 30px, letter-spacing -0.005em | 600 | `sans` | Page title in the top bar of every screen. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 18px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Section and card titles. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 15px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | Sub-sections inside cards, modal titles, form group titles. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI and paragraph text. Never go below 14px for reading text. |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 14px / 22px | 500 | `sans` | Names in tables, emphasised values. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `sans` | Form labels, button text (sm), tab labels, table headers. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Helper text, timestamps, table meta. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.02em | 500 | `sans` | Badges and sidebar section headings only. Smallest size allowed. |
| `mono` | `.mono`, `--text-mono` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | IDs, invoice numbers, codes. For money and counts in tables use body with tabular numbers instead. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, "Courier New", monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, badge padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between related controls, button icon gap. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Table cell vertical padding, field gap inside a group. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding (compact), gap between form fields. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Modal padding, gap between cards. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding (default), page side padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between page sections. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Empty-state padding. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Top/bottom breathing room on large pages. |
